name: PhysGaussian
definition: A method using the Material Point Method (MPM) over Gaussians, providing one representation for both rendering and simulation of materials like cloth, jelly, sand, and snow.
summary: PhysGaussian couples 3D Gaussian Splatting with the Material Point Method to enable simultaneous high-fidelity rendering and physical simulation of deformable materials by embedding physical properties into Gaussian primitives.
